For places and environments of any kind the whole scene is built as a diorama in the same material; the setting comes only from the request. Not painted wood, not a render.

name: Dave McKean Style Mixed Media Collage
suffix: Mixed-media collage in the manner of Dave McKean and Bill Sienkiewicz, applied to the subject of the request only; no extra figures, no readable text. Limited palette of muted sepia, bone and slate with one bruised accent. Form built from layered photographic fragments, paint, ink scratches and found textures; lighting direction and time of day follow the request. Torn and scraped edges, overlapping transparencies, fragmented dreamlike surfaces. For places and environments of any kind the same layered photo-and-paint texture; the setting comes only from the request. Not clean digital, not a photograph.

name: Dada Photomontage
suffix: Dada photomontage in the manner of Hannah Höch and John Heartfield, applied to the subject of the request only; no extra figures, no readable text. Black and white photographic fragments with sparse red accents. Form assembled from cut-out photo pieces at mixed scales; lighting varies fragment to fragment. Sharp scissor edges, vintage halftone grain, visible overlaps. For places and environments of any kind the same cut-photo assembly; the setting comes only from the request. Not digital collage, not a painting.
